title: Specwake HTTP MCP connection v1
description: Data-only connection description for the currently supported same-machine, stateless Streamable HTTP MCP service. Tool discovery is performed on connect.

endpoint.description: Exact current loopback endpoint, port 1-65535. No userinfo, query, fragment, secret headers, alternate paths or remote addresses. Export only while the service is running; a saved file is not proof of liveness.

authentication.description: The current local MCP demo has no client authentication. This is unrelated to upstream API credentials.

scope.description: 127.0.0.1 refers to the machine running the client. Sharing this file does not create access to another machine.
